target: roadside fruit stands and farm stands North Shore and Windward Oahu (Kahuku, Laie, Hauula, Kaaawa, Waiahole, Waimanalo)

rows.name: Frankie's Nursery Fruit Stand
rows.schedule_text: Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00am to 3:00pm. Closed Sunday and Monday.
rows.description: Fruit stand at a tropical fruit-tree nursery selling fruit harvested daily from mature trees plus homemade tropical juices. Fruit varies by season; the site gives mangoes as primarily a summer fruit and durians as a winter fruit. Visitors can walk the nursery grounds, where the fruit trees are for sale.
rows.notes: Own page, but it carries no update date (footer shows 2022), so current hours should be confirmed. The site shows an Instagram link but no handle, so instagram is null.

rows.name: Kahuku Land Farms Stand (Kahuku fruit stands)
rows.schedule_text: 2017 Star-Advertiser: open daily during daylight hours.
rows.description: Collective of roadside fruit stands on Kamehameha Hwy, mauka side, across from the Kawela Bay entrance just past Turtle Bay Resort on the way toward Haleiwa. Sells bags of cut fruit, whole fruit, some vegetables, and cut coconuts. Much of the fruit is grown on farms just behind the stands.
rows.notes: Sources are old. A Hawaii Life blog post (https://www.hawaiilife.com/blog/kahuku-land-farms-fruit-stands-new-rules/) says conservation-easement rules for the surrounding land could change how the stands operate. A recent Hawaii Life guide lists 'Kahuku Fruit Stands' as a permanent structure tied to Kahuku Farms, open daily 9am to 5pm. That conflicts with the independent-stand description, and Kahuku Farms is already in the directory. A recent TikTok caption (updated 2026-10-26) also mentions a 'Kahuku Fruit Stand', so it appears to still operate, but the exact operator and current hours are unverified. No street address was stated in a usable source.

rows.name: Red Barn Farmstand
rows.schedule_text: Wednesday through Sunday, 8:00am to 3:00pm (per a Hawaii Life guide).
rows.description: Permanent red-barn farm stand that sells local farmers' produce and island-made goods, with grab-and-go food, coffee and occasional community events. Opened October 2016 on the corner of Kamehameha Hwy and Cane Haul Road.
rows.source_label: Hawaii Life, A Guide to North Shore Oahu Farmers' Markets
rows.notes: I could not open the organizer's own site. Other listings I saw (not used as sources) conflict on hours and appear to mark the business as closed. Confirm it is currently operating before publishing. Phone per the guide: (808) 753-4350.

rows.name: North Shore Farm Stand
rows.address: Hale'iwa Road at Paalaa Rd, Haleiwa, Hawaii 96712
rows.schedule_text: Wednesdays 12pm to 6pm per the contact page. The home page says Wednesdays and Thursdays 12pm to 6pm.
rows.description: Farm stand that brings together produce and products from North Shore farmers, homesteaders and entrepreneurs, including fresh local food, pantry items and natural medicine. Tours or classes can be booked through the contact listed on the site.
rows.source_label: North Shore Farm Stand official website (home and contact pages)
rows.notes: The site's own pages disagree on days (Wednesday only vs. Wednesday and Thursday), so confirm before publishing. The contact page also lists a Saturday 8:30am to 1pm Waialua Farmer's Market, which is already in the directory. The site names an Instagram contact for tours, but it is a person's handle, so I did not record it as the business's.

rows.name: Waimānalo Farmers Market
rows.description: Community market on the Windward Coast with seasonal fruits and vegetables and locally made dishes from vendors such as Hawaiian Island Café.
rows.source_label: Honolulu Magazine, Your Guide to Farmers Markets on O‘ahu
rows.notes: This is a farmers market rather than a roadside stand, included because it is a recurring Waimānalo produce venue. The Instagram handle (@nalofarmersmarket) is as printed in the magazine guide, which was indexed about 19 days before this research. The organizer is not named in the source.

rows.name: Waimanalo Beach Park People's Open Market
rows.schedule_text: Thursday mornings. One listing says 7:15am to 8:15am; another says 7:00am to 8:00am.
rows.description: People's Open Market stop, a program that helps farmers sell off-grade and surplus produce at lower prices. Offers fruits, vegetables and other items not always available in grocery stores. The listing places it on Kalanianaʻole Highway near the baseball fields.
rows.source_label: Soko app market listing; hours cross-checked with vendorsmap.com
rows.notes: Third-party aggregators only, and the hours differ between them. The venue name (Waimanalo Beach Park) comes from vendorsmap.com, and one aggregator's data appears to date from 2015. Confirm with the City's People's Open Market schedule. The organizer is not named in these sources.

rows.name: Mahiku Farmers Market
rows.description: Listed by a market aggregator as a weekly market bringing together local growers and food producers in Waimānalo.
rows.notes: Thin aggregator listing with no verified schedule or organizer. Verify that it is active before publishing.

rows.name: Waimea Valley Farmers Market
rows.description: North Shore weekly farmers market listed in a Hawaii Life guide to North Shore farmers' markets and farm stands.
rows.source_label: Hawaii Life, A Guide to North Shore Oahu Farmers' Markets
rows.notes: Farmers market, not a roadside stand. The guide gave no address or venue in the text I retrieved, so those are null. The guide was indexed about 220 days before this research.

rows.name: Kualoa Coconut Man
rows.description: Simple roadside stand on Kamehameha Highway selling fresh coconuts opened on the spot, plus fruit such as bananas and papaya.
rows.source_label: FastFoodClub article, 6 Hawaii Roadside Stands (indexed about 31 days before this research)
rows.notes: The article gives the location only as Kamehameha Highway in Kaneohe, with no street address or hours. A separate aggregator page garbles the address, so I left it null. Verify the exact location and hours before publishing.
